decision_points.requirement: One active effective grant and its exact revision come from the same capability_grant current result; list digests and historical evaluation results cannot authorize signing.
A stale basis writes nothing, and concurrent revoke and relinquish against one revision have exactly one winner.
A refreshed revision requires explicit reconfirmation, while unauthorized, missing and terminal targets expose no authorable row and remain indistinguishable.

cases.name: active_row_supplies_exact_atomic_revision
assertions: grant and revision are read from one durable capability_grant current result
the row revision is copied verbatim only after explicit user confirmation

cases.name: historical_evaluation_must_refresh_before_authoring
assertions: a query carrying at is evaluation-only and produces no authoring submission
the client refreshes without at and requires new confirmation

cases.name: list_digest_is_not_revision
assertions: state_digest never substitutes for a missing CurrentRevision
no signature or submission is produced without the row revision

cases.name: stale_revision_conflicts_without_write
assertions: a stale exact revision returns cas_conflict with zero projection writes
refresh never silently re-signs against a replacement revision

cases.name: concurrent_revoke_and_relinquish_have_one_winner
assertions: revoke and relinquish sharing one expected revision have exactly one successful commit
the losing operation has no durable or projection effect

cases.name: refresh_requires_explicit_reconfirmation
assertions: a changed revision invalidates the earlier confirmation
the client blocks submission until the user confirms the refreshed row

cases.name: unreadable_missing_and_terminal_are_non_enumerating
assertions: unauthorized missing revoked and relinquished targets expose no effective row
their caller-visible outcome is indistinguishable and cannot be authored
